VBO:0200841.summary: Built for hauling heavy loads, Mackenzie River Huskies belong to a varied northern freight-dog tradition. Small teams worked through deep snow, wooded trails and hilly terrain. Different villages maintained and named their own dogs; the broad Mackenzie River label has covered several populations rather than one uniform breed.
VBO:0200841.shortDescription: Named for varied northern freight-dog populations, Mackenzie River Huskies worked in small teams hauling heavy loads through snow.
